teachers: 授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Japanese Communication 2 is designed to reinforce basic grammar through communication tasks. Students will focus on developing basic skills of communication in modern Japanese reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
advice:
Students will be able to handle a wider variety of conversational situations and read and write simple letters and essays. They will also become familiar with various aspects of Japanese culture, including sociolinguistic elements essential for accurate communication. Five chapters (Lessons 11-15) will be covered, and 78 new kanji will be introduced.

This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on this site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.

- Pick up important information from authentic materials.
- Develop effective study skills.

              Japanese Communication 2 is designed to reinforce basic grammar through communication tasks. Students will focus on developing basic skills of communication in modern Japanese reading, writing, speaking, and listening.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students will be able to handle a wider variety of conversational situations and read and write simple letters and essays. They will also become familiar with various aspects of Japanese culture, including sociolinguistic elements essential for accurate communication. Five chapters (Lessons 11-15) will be covered, and 78 new kanji will be introduced.

This course has a Moodle course site. All important information about course related matters will be posted on this site. It is students' responsibility to check the site regularly.
